recentPerformanceReview.conclusion: Seven researched picks yielded one official winner (Yordan, Southwell 19:30, 7/4 SP, preserved 3/1 early quote). One of four original WIN picks succeeded; the other E/W/outsider candidates did not place. No 15 Oct paper wager was recorded.
lessons: Require today's precise track/going/distance match; Yordan returned to proven standard Tapeta 6f and won by 3¾ lengths.
A prior big-margin win is not enough if latest OR rose sharply or racecourse layout is new; Shifra/Nouvel Espoir were fifth.
Do not requalify after a race: Major Fortune remains in originally published WIN denominator even though withdrawn at noon.
Do not choose outsiders solely for old C&D wins and dropping marks; demand recent competitive form.
These seven outcomes alone do not validate any new model weighting or increased strike rate.
recentPerformanceReview.pricing: Yordan researched early quote remains 3/1; confirmed SP is 7/4 favourite. No paper stakes or bookmaker BOG are presumed.

fiveDayAnalysis.caveat: Different revisions and selection groups were used across the days, so pooled profit and calibrated accuracy cannot be inferred from the totals. Observed outcomes never justify retroactive removal.
processChanges: Compare best candidates to all significant live rivals and examine where the rival can improve, instead of celebrating only our horse's positives.
Treat older course-and-distance wins as secondary support; foreground current speed/class performance at the actual conditions.
Include days since run, rating/weight change, and evidence for track and trip as separate explicit risk checks.
Do not increase confidence based solely on a rival non-runner; recalculate the surviving field's strengths and pace shape.
Preserve the originally published pick, reference odds, non-runners and later result without reclassifying unsuccessful bets.
Display one horse per race and its recommended WIN/EACH WAY bet type; price is not a confidence input.
Recheck declared runners, going, jockey and each-way bookmaker place terms before off; no invented certainty or profit.

morningRecheck.incorrectPreliminaryNonRunner: Opportunity remains a runner in 13:30; do not treat the initial mention as confirmed.
morningRecheck.methodology: No tip-text inputs. Compare OR, RPR, TS, age allowances, recent form, historical course/going suitability and named rival strength; market quotes shown but excluded from confidence scoring.
morningRecheck.dataLimitations: Published ratings summarize past performances, not a licensed sectionals-based or calibrated win-probability model.
